name: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision optical components, fiber optic devices, and optical testing instruments in China and internationally. The company's precision optics components include crystal materials, planar optical elements, spherical optical elements, molded glass aspherical lenses, diffraction gratings, and optical assemblies; fiber optic devices, such as coated fiber optic devices, collimators, acousto-optic devices, and others fiber optics; optical testing instruments, comprising tunable lasers, laser scanning analyzers, and optical equipment and modules.
